reason: Oh-My-DSH is an automated discovery and cataloging engine that scans multiple public sources, validates DeepSeek Harness plugin candidates, categorizes them, and periodically updates its README index.

summaries.zh: Oh-My-DSH 是一个自动扫描多个公开来源、验证并分类 DeepSeek Harness 插件候选项目的生态发现与目录更新工具。
summaries.en: Oh-My-DSH is an automated ecosystem discovery tool that scans public sources, validates and categorizes DeepSeek Harness plugin candidates, and updates an indexed catalog.

capabilities: Scans multiple external sources for DeepSeek Harness plugin candidates
Optionally uses a GitHub token for repository discovery
Runs on an hourly schedule and updates the repository README
Uses repository-side locking and rollback procedures for automated updates
